_readme: WHAT NEVER TRAVELS from localhost to the live site. You may edit this file. Every report prints it. Anything not listed here travels (new rows and changed rows only).

excludedTables._prisma_migrations: database version bookkeeping (prisma migrate deploy owns it)
excludedTables.Integration: integration credentials and tokens (WhatsApp, Meta, SMTP, SMS, Naukri, Shine, AI keys...). The live site's own connections must never be overwritten
excludedTables.IntegrationEvent: integration activity log of this machine
excludedTables.PortalPosting: job posting worker state of this machine
excludedTables.ScheduledMessage: outbound message queue (would send messages twice)
excludedTables.Notification: bell notifications belong to the machine that raised them
excludedTables.BiometricDevice: device connection settings of this machine
excludedTables.BiometricDeviceUser: device connection settings of this machine
excludedTables.BiometricPunchLog: raw punch log fed by the device on the live site
excludedTables.Conversation: live WhatsApp/chat conversations belong to the live site
excludedTables.ConversationMessage: live WhatsApp/chat messages belong to the live site
excludedTables.CandidateMessage: messages already sent from this machine (test sends); live messages belong to the live site
excludedTables.LeaveRequest: LEAVE MANAGEMENT lives on the live site (requests, approvals). Never touched by a sync
excludedTables.LeaveBalance: LEAVE MANAGEMENT lives on the live site. Never touched by a sync
excludedTables.LeaveType: LEAVE MANAGEMENT settings live on the live site. Never touched by a sync
excludedTables.LeaveReason: LEAVE MANAGEMENT settings live on the live site. Never touched by a sync
excludedTables.Holiday: holiday calendar belongs to leave management on the live site
excludedTables.Task: TIMESHEET tasks are entered on the live site. Never touched by a sync
excludedTables.TaskComment: TIMESHEET task comments are entered on the live site. Never touched by a sync
excludedTables.Attendance: attendance (biometric / check-in) is written by the live site. Never touched by a sync
excludedTables.AttendancePunch: biometric punches are written by the live site. Never touched by a sync
excludedTables.AttendanceRegularization: attendance requests belong to the live site. Never touched by a sync
excludedTables.AttendanceHistory: attendance history belongs to the live site. Never touched by a sync
excludedTables.AttendanceHistorySummary: attendance history belongs to the live site. Never touched by a sync
excludedTables.MessageTemplate: e-mail / WhatsApp / SMS message templates are SETTINGS of the live site. Remove this line only if you want local template edits to travel
excludedTables.MessageTemplateVersion: e-mail / WhatsApp / SMS message template versions: see MessageTemplate
excludedTables.OmniCreditLedger: message-credit ledger: entries written by whichever machine sent the messages (credits belong to the live account)
excludedTables.OmniCreditAllowance: message-credit allowances belong to the live account
excludedTables.OmniRecharge: message-credit recharges belong to the live account

excludedNamePatterns.reason: name looks like session / queue / cache / heartbeat
WhatsApp account data (templates, opt-ins, logs, bulk sessions) belongs to the live WhatsApp connection

alwaysPushTables.AuditLog: the audit trail documents the work (insert-only)
alwaysPushTables.AssetAuditLog: the audit trail documents the work (insert-only)
alwaysPushTables.CandidateMergeLog: records which duplicate candidates were merged
alwaysPushTables.JobMergeLog: records which duplicate jobs were merged

excludeWhere.reason: TIMESHEET entries are typed on the live site (EmployeeRecord also holds KT, targets, resignations... which DO travel)

ignoreColumnsNote: Login counters / one-time codes are never compared and never written. New rows get the column default on the live site.
softColumnsNote: Time-stamp columns never cause a conflict. They are written only when the live site's value is still the old one. A row that differs ONLY in these columns is not a change.
testRowNote: Any new/changed row whose text contains one of these is test data and never travels (nor rows that point to it).

type-in dropdown lists (skills, industries...) that users extend
reasons.stationery.defaultKit: default joining kit (HR choice); NOT its .lastRun marker
reasons.job-templates: job description templates (text written by the team)

appSetting.note: Every other AppSetting key is EXCLUDED by default (counters like autoNumber:*, WhatsApp wa.* / comm.* / msg.optout.* / webhook.seen.*, posting state, payroll snapshots, reminders, agreement links, one-time idem.*). The report lists excluded keys that differ so you can add one to the allow lists above.
